synopsis: At Antiquity's End Rasler appears to the party, Ashe, Vaan, Penelo, Fran, Basch and Balthier (Balflear), over nine cuts after the screen fades.
plays_when: In Antiquity's End (The Feywood), when the party walks into an event area (the script's イベントレクト), which the map places with the story counter from 4100 (After the truth clouded by Mist) and below 4160 (After the Mist wall opens) (mfr_a04 lines 1176 and 1178): the preload reads the scene on arrival with the counter above 0 and below 4160 (After the Mist wall opens) (lines 1056 and 1059) and the map starts it with the counter from 4100 (After the truth clouded by Mist) and below 4160 (After the Mist wall opens) (lines 1223 and 1225), and it holds (mfr_a0400 line 35) until the area's touch releases it (mfr_a04 lines 1086 and 1306); the touch then waits for the scene's end (line 1307) and sets the story counter to 4160 (After the Mist wall opens) (line 1309). Before the release the touch has no return; its break (line 1249) only ends a case of the switch at line 1244.

synopsis: Rafflesia appears in Redolent Glade and the fight begins to Clash of Swords (track 206).
plays_when: in Redolent Glade (The Feywood), when the party arrives while Rafflesia is undefeated (the battle byte, global byte 0xA0D, is 1 from the new game, pre_z0000 line 340, until the win): Rafflesia appears and the battle begins (mfr_b01 lines 358 and 362 under the test at line 352). The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 296) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 319 and 330).

synopsis: Rafflesia falls in Redolent Glade and the remaining foes are removed.
plays_when: in Redolent Glade (The Feywood), when Rafflesia is defeated: the script starts it on arrival together with the opening scene (mfr_b01 lines 360 and 363 under the test at line 352), and it holds (mfr_b0101 line 42) until the script releases it after the win (mfr_b01 line 439), and the win sets the battle byte (global byte 0xA0D) to 2 (mfr_b01 line 605), so neither scene plays again. The map's replay menu, which reads it again, is never reached: the script jumps past it on entry (line 296) and only the menu's own choices jump back into it (lines 319 and 330).

synopsis: At The Edge of Reason Belias (actor Velius; the zone script plays the scene from イベント管理.ベリアス開門_再生, 'Belias opens the gate') appears with its weapon and the Gigas gate opens over six cuts, while the leader watches and the music fades out.
plays_when: In The Edge of Reason (The Feywood), when the party examines the colossal gate (the script's gil_gate) with Belias summoned and chooses "Touch the gate." (its question is message 3) while bit 0x80 of a saved word (mp_gil_flg00, global byte 0x920) is set and the story counter is below 4250 (After To the ancient city of Giruvegan): the preload reads the scene on arrival with the counter below 4250 (After To the ancient city of Giruvegan) (mfr_c03 lines 252 and 255) and the map starts it with the same counter (lines 159 and 161), and it holds (mfr_c0300 line 29) until the talk (mfr_c03 lines 1321, 1328, 1344, 1345, 1347 and 1349) requests a function of the map's event actor (the script's イベント管理.ベリアス開門_再生) (mfr_c03 line 1373), which releases it (mfr_c03 lines 177 and 282), waits for its end (mfr_c03 line 178), sets the story counter to 4230 (After the Giruvegan gate) (mfr_c03 line 179) and takes the party to Gate of Earth (Giruvegan), field 686, entrance 4 (mfr_c03 line 196). getsummonid() returns the Esper being summoned (verb-table-inputs.tsv), and 27 is Belias's Esper id (action-list.tsv). Without Belias the talk says "Strong magicks bind the gate. It will not open." (message 6, mfr_c03 lines 1375 and 1379). Outside the developer scripts, the bit is set at one line, and no line clears it: the touch of the area at one of the five Feywood Glyphs (the script's hokora04.touchon; its sign shows section 3 caption 6, "Feywood Glyph", mfr_c03 lines 1227 and 1273) sets it (mfr_c03 line 971) when one of three scratch bytes holds the value it tests (mfr_c03 line 956). The touches at three other glyphs set those bytes in the same visit (mfr_c03 lines 762 and 763, 837 and 838, 900 and 901) and a second saved word (mp_gil_flg01, global byte 0x921) (mfr_c03 lines 772, 778, 784, 847 and 910), from which the map's director sets them again on a later arrival (mfr_c03 lines 600, 605, 610, 615 and 620). The byte its case reads (mfr_c03 line 967) is 1 either way: the draw rand_29(1) plus 1 (a random number from 0 to n - 1, here always 0) when the byte is 0 (mfr_c03 lines 960, 963 and 964), else the director's 1, stored when the bit 0x20 that the same touch sets is on (mfr_c03 lines 976 and 625); the map's only other store to it is the 0 of the director's setup (mfr_c03 line 558). Of the 1,875 us scripts, through any name or array that covers global byte 0x920, three store to it besides this one: mfr_c02, which sets bits 0x1 to 0x10 (mfr_c02 lines 399, 405, 467, 530 and 591), and two developer scripts, which no path array names (developer-script-list.tsv): the debug menu evt_t0081 stores 0, clears bit 0x80 and stores 181 (0xB5, bit 0x80 set) (evt_t0081 lines 6194, 6373 and 6383), and the test script evt_t0505 stores 181 (evt_t0505 line 489). Two developer menus of the controller scripts can also fill every byte of the global area with 255 or 0 (../Scripts-And-Script-Commands/script-variables.md).
